name: FDA menopause diagnostic reference (ingested prior)
note: Research reference used as a PRIOR only. It does NOT produce a diagnosis and MUST NOT be treated as a certainty. Values are illustrative summaries of publicly documented staging concepts (STRAW+10) and FDA-style reproductive hormone diagnostic reference ranges. Verify against primary sources before any clinical interpretation.

stages.label: Late reproductive
stages.description: Regular cycles, subtle decline in fecundity.

stages.label: Early perimenopause
stages.description: Variable cycle length; early vasomotor symptoms may begin.

stages.label: Late perimenopause
stages.description: Amenorrhea intervals >= 60 days; vasomotor symptoms more prominent.

stages.label: Early postmenopause
stages.description: 12 months amenorrhea; FSH elevated, estradiol low; symptoms variable.

stages.label: Late postmenopause
stages.description: Further stabilization; vasomotor symptoms generally wane.

hormone_reference.note: Illustrative ranges only. Units and cut-offs vary by assay/lab.
